about.title: 34 years on Europe's roads
about.paragraph1: SAŠA KOMERC DOOEL was founded in 1992 by Saša Spasovski, at a time when international transport out of Macedonia demanded more than just a fleet of trucks — it demanded persistence, reputation, and personal relationships built over years. What began as a modest venture has grown into a recognised freight forwarding company that today operates a fleet of over 40 trucks and connects clients from Skopje to destinations across Western and Northern Europe every single day.
about.paragraph2: Through all these decades, the philosophy has stayed the same: every shipment is treated personally, every deadline is honoured as our own, and every client speaks directly to the people who actually run the business. That closeness — combined with a seriousness that matches European standards — is what allowed us to build a long-term partnership with LKW Walter, one of Europe's leading transport organisations, and to earn the trust of partners who need consistency, not just haulage.
about.paragraph3: Today, the SAŠA KOMERC team, led by founder Saša Spasovski and Marija Jordanova, continues to work with the same dedication the company was built on more than three decades ago — available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, for every client who needs a partner they can truly rely on.
about.missionText: To provide fast, reliable and transparent international transport and freight forwarding, building lasting partnerships through personal responsibility and professionalism at every step of the journey.
about.visionText: To remain a recognised, trusted family carrier that matches the flexibility and experience of the largest European logistics companies, without ever losing the personal touch in our work.

transport.title: International Road Transport
transport.summary: Direct transport of goods with our own fleet of 40+ trucks along the NL-SE-NL and DE-SE-DE round trip routes, with full responsibility for the timeliness and safety of the cargo.
transport.detail: Our transport relies on well-planned round trips — Netherlands–Sweden–Netherlands and Germany–Sweden–Germany — which allows maximum capacity utilisation and shorter delivery times in both directions. The fleet consists of tractor units with semi-trailers, Euro 5 and Euro 6 standard, with a maximum capacity of up to 25 tonnes per vehicle. Our drivers operate both our own trailers and trailers from the network of our partner LKW Walter, which further increases flexibility when picking up and delivering cargo across Western Europe. Every shipment is tracked from departure to delivery, with direct communication with the client at every stage.

forwarding.title: Freight Forwarding & Logistics
forwarding.summary: Full organisation of the transport — from documentation and customs coordination to route planning and constant communication with partners across Europe.
forwarding.detail: Freight forwarding is the heart of what we do. Before a shipment ever hits the road, our team coordinates every step required for smooth, legally compliant international transport — transport documentation, CMR consignment notes, aligning loading and unloading windows, and continuous communication with shippers, consignees and partner carriers in the Netherlands, Germany, Sweden and Belgium. With decades of experience working with European partners, we know how to anticipate potential delays and act early, instead of waiting for a problem to appear on its own. The result is transport that runs smoothly, with clear communication at every step, whether it's a one-off shipment or a regular monthly route.

trucking.title: Trucking — Intermodal Transport
trucking.summary: Decoupling and coupling of trailers at rail terminals and ports, for flexible combinations of road, rail and sea transport.
trucking.detail: Alongside classic road transport, we also offer a trucking service — decoupling and coupling trailers at rail terminals and port facilities, in cooperation with the LKW Walter network. This service allows cargo to travel part of the way by rail or sea, and part by road, depending on what is fastest, most economical and safest for a specific shipment. For clients, this means greater flexibility in planning, a smaller environmental footprint on longer legs, and access to an intermodal network that spans all of Europe. Our team coordinates all the logistics around the terminals — precise arrival times, correct coupling/decoupling, and a seamless continuation of transport to the final destination.

fleet.title: 40+ trucks ready for every haul
fleet.paragraph1: The SAŠA KOMERC fleet today counts over 40 trucks — tractor units with semi-trailers, compliant with the Euro 5 and Euro 6 environmental standards. Each vehicle can carry cargo weighing up to 25 tonnes, covering the needs of nearly every type of general cargo on long-distance European routes.
fleet.paragraph2: SAŠA KOMERC drivers operate both our own trailers and trailers from the network of our long-standing partner LKW Walter, which significantly increases flexibility when picking up new cargo, regardless of where in Europe the vehicle happens to be. This combination of owned capacity and access to a partner network allows us to respond quickly, even to requests with tight deadlines.

partner.title: Part of the LKW Walter network
partner.paragraph1: LKW Walter (Internationale Transportorganisation AG) is one of Europe's leading international transport organisations, headquartered in Austria, with a carrier network spanning thousands of vehicles across the continent. SAŠA KOMERC has proudly been a partner in this network for a long time, giving us access to additional loads, trailers and logistics support across Western and Northern Europe.
partner.paragraph2: This partnership is not just a business agreement — it's confirmation of the quality and seriousness with which SAŠA KOMERC has operated for three decades. Being part of the LKW Walter network requires consistently meeting strict standards for safety, quality and reliability, and our team holds certificates that confirm exactly that.
